_comment: Exchange is binance because the probe on 2026-07-30 showed Kraken's public OHLC endpoint ignores `since` and serves only its most recent ~30 days, making a 2-year backfill impossible there. Binance honoured a 730-day `since` and returns 500 candles per page (bybit 199, okx 100), so it needs the fewest requests. Note binance.com quotes in USDT rather than USD.
